systems.system: Toamasina grid load-shedding after Cyclone Gezani
systems.country_label: About 4 MW offline causing continuing load-shedding in Toamasina (August 2026); one exporter, Jacarandas, reports an average of five outages a day (one customer, not the grid)

note: No whole-grid interruption frequency; the five-outages-a-day figure is one firm's account in Toamasina, and the text is cut off.
